name: hud_ui_message_select_variant_display
description: HudUiMessage::SelectVariantDisplay selects the message variant image and updates side-image state.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?SelectVariantDisplay@HudUiMessage@@SIXHH@Z at 0x4126e0 currently fails with 330 unmasked mismatches after masking 40 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 170 bytes, the VC object symbol is 384 bytes with 6 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/hud_ui_message_select_variant_and_clear_display/verify/4126e0_byte_triage.txt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4126e0 selects g_HudUiMgrMessages[messageIndex], assigns base.image from variantImages[variantIndex] through HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate, swaps side-image state for variants 0 or 3 and 1 or 4, and records activeSideIndex 0 for variants 0, 3, or 5 and 1 for variants 1, 4, or 6.
The native smoke verifies variant 0 and variant 1 selection update the base image, widget image, side-image slots, and active side index.
